svg.title: One evening at three degrees outside: the planner against a thermostat tuned for five
svg.desc: The target is 12 degrees until step 25 and 18 after. The planner heats almost from the start and reads 17.8 at step 25, then stays above 18. The thermostat, switched eleven steps early, reads 17.0 when the person arrives and is short for five readings.
svg.text: Room under the thermostat, lead tuned for 5°
